scope.preservation: lab.js and build-share.mjs already had unrelated working-tree changes. Existing meeting/discovery/journey/launcher/host-isolation changes were preserved. lab.js edits are consultation messages only; build-share.mjs edits bundle discovery's meeting-regions dependency and reject leftover static imports.

changes.behavior: Match whole present self statements through their predicates instead of extracting loose keyword substrings. Explicit self or exact omitted-subject personal forms can propose supported facts. Unrecognized subjects, denial, history, transitions, uncertainty, quotation and compound clauses remain held. Quotation and unresolved subject scope survive periods; explicit self can resume matching.
positivePreserved: web AI distinguished from installed local AI
named local tools and model size
changes.limitation: A deliberately narrow local Korean expression matcher, not general free-language understanding. Every emitted proposal still requires existing confirmation.

changes.behavior: Before a text edit clears source proposals, compare active parent answers and retire manual dependent details whose parent disappeared. Re-enabling the use/device cannot revive old details. Keep independent answers and details whose parent is still manually selected.

Ask still prioritizes positive declared question value, then the same question card requests missing or invalid required product fields. Required confirmations are not falsely assigned a recommendation value or listed as skipped. Explicit unknown stays provisional without repeated questions. Inactive branches and optional questions remain outside required completion.
Bundle meeting-regions.mjs inside discovery's closure, strip its exact import, and fail the build before writing a share page if static import/export statements remain.

fidelity.interpretation: Synthetic catalog answer combinations, not measured real-user quality. Four remaining whole-advice differences are RAM differences with zero worse cases under the declared policy loss.
